baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction إِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ joins a feminine singular one-of expression to a plural class of great things.
baseline_models.mechanism: Partitive selection isolates one member while the greatness branch supplies the scale of the containing class; the focus alone does not identify the feminine referent.

activation_trace.role: The one-as-first-or-one-of image supplies partitive membership in a larger class.
Greatness opposed to smallness makes that class exceptional in magnitude or degree.

changed_reading.before: The clause is only an emphatic assertion about an unspecified feminine referent.
changed_reading.after: The referent is classified as one distinct member of a plurality of things exceptional in magnitude.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْكُبَرِ can carry weight and consequence rather than only physical or scalar size.
baseline_models.mechanism: The selected member belongs among affairs whose chief burden and experienced heaviness make them great.

activation_trace.role: The one-of image selects a member from a consequential class.
The chief-share or bulk image supplies dominant consequence rather than mere dimensions.
The hardship-and-heaviness image makes greatness an experienced load.

changed_reading.before: Greatness is heard mainly as high rank or large scale.
changed_reading.after: The referent is one of the affairs great because it carries a chief burden and hard weight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same ٱلْكُبَرِ inventory includes the branch of major sins and grave offenses.
baseline_models.mechanism: If the feminine pronoun packages an act or stance, the partitive construction can classify it among grave offenses rather than among large phenomena.

activation_trace.role: The one-of image provides membership in a class of offenses.
The major-sin image supplies a juridical-moral class for the otherwise open referent.

changed_reading.before: The greats are momentous things or events.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the clause can classify a referenced deed or stance as one of the grave offenses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The open feminine member is narrowed toward Saqar, and its greatness becomes operational: encounter with fire, cancellation of remainder, visible heat-effect on the human surface, and a warning that awakens caution form one causal threat-system.

activation_trace.role: The one-of image retains classification while context supplies the likely member.
Hardship and heaviness recast greatness as severe experienced consequence.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies the bodily encounter at the start of the threat mechanism.
Persistence and remaining are locally negated, making the fire's operation exhaustive.
The heat-effect that changes color makes the threat visibly material.
The exposed skin-or-surface image locates the heat's visible effect on the human exterior.
Warning that frightens and awakens caution assigns the severe operation a preventive function.

structural_cues: 74:26-27 names Saqar, while 74:28-30 continues with its effects and what is over it before the feminine pronoun in 74:35.
74:36 immediately presents a warning function directed to humankind.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire-contact, denied remainder, marked surface, and warning; I supply the antecedent link to Saqar and the arrow from those operations to consequential greatness. A live alternative is that the pronoun targets the fire, its count, or the reminder more broadly.

changed_reading.before: An unidentified item is ranked among great things.
changed_reading.after: Saqar is heard as one great embodied warning whose magnitude lies in its exhaustive effect and capacity to awaken caution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit nineteen and its counted status activate the counting branch of إِحْدَى; because that count assays people and yields certainty or its opposite, the great member becomes an enumerated epistemic test rather than a vaguely immense object.

activation_trace.role: One in counting and compound numerals makes the focus term responsive to the nearby explicit number.
The chief-burden image lets greatness describe the count's decisive epistemic work.
The number nine supplies the first explicit component of nineteen.
The number ten completes the compound count that primes the focus one's numerical branch.
Enumerating a counted set makes number itself an active mechanism rather than incidental detail.
The assay of metal or person turns the count into a discriminator of response.
Settled knowledge and removal of doubt supply one outcome produced by the assay.

structural_cues: 74:30 gives nineteen, and 74:31 immediately calls their number a trial before listing divergent reactions.
The numerical and reaction sequence stands directly before the oath sequence that culminates in 74:35.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a compound number, explicit enumeration, assay, and certainty; I map that count-frame back to the focus one's numerical branch and treat sorting power as greatness. The live alternative is that counting only frames Saqar without changing the pronoun's referent.

changed_reading.before: One-of is an idiomatic marker of membership among great things.
changed_reading.after: One is re-heard as an enumerative unit, and the great thing functions as a counted assay that separates epistemic responses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places commanded magnification of the Lord against a man's self-magnifying refusal; the focus recurrence therefore acts as a verdict within a contest over what truly deserves greatness, not as neutral size language.

activation_trace.role: The one-of image identifies the warning phenomenon as a member of the class that judges claims to greatness.
Grandeur and self-magnification supply the focus word's morally polarized scale.
The imperative to magnify the Lord locates rightful grandeur at one pole.
Human self-exaltation and refusal of truth provide the counterfeit pole that the warning overturns.

structural_cues: 74:3 commands magnifying the Lord, whereas 74:23 pairs turning away with self-magnification.
74:35 repeats the same root after the resistant man's judgment and the description of Saqar.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed uses of the same root; I infer that their recurrence evaluates rival greatness claims and that the great warning defeats self-greatness. The live alternative is simple lexical repetition without a designed polarity.

changed_reading.before: The focus calls its referent objectively large or momentous.
changed_reading.after: The focus declares one decisive manifestation of true greatness that exposes human self-magnification as false.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night's passage and dawn's removal of covering establish a cosmic transition; the following advance-or-delay pair turns that transition into human orientation, so the great referent is read dynamically as a disclosure-threshold that separates directions.

activation_trace.role: The one-of image classifies this boundary as one among the major thresholds.
Great degree supplies the threshold's exceptional scale.
The ending and passing-away image makes night one side of a phase boundary.
Removal of covering makes dawn's arrival an act of disclosure.
Forward movement and precedence supply one human trajectory opened by the warning.
Delay to a later position supplies the opposed trajectory at the same decision boundary.

structural_cues: 74:32-34 forms an oath sequence of moon, retreating night, and revealing dawn immediately before the focus.
74:36-37 follows the focus with warning and the paired alternatives of advancing and delaying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered cosmic phase change and opposed human movement; I supply the arrow that makes the focus referent a threshold translating disclosure into decision. The live alternative is that these images frame, but do not redefine, Saqar's greatness.

changed_reading.before: The focus ranks a static object or event among the greats.
changed_reading.after: The focus marks one great disclosure-threshold at which hidden consequence becomes visible and a person moves forward or falls behind.

context_deltas.mechanism: The solitary individual at creation and the later universal statement about each self under pledge activate the individual-by-individual branch of إِحْدَى; the warning's greatness lies partly in total reach implemented one person at a time.

activation_trace.role: Isolation and individual-by-individual distribution turn focus singularity into an individuating operation.
Chief consequence makes universal individual accountability a source of greatness.
Solitude and separation establish the resistant person first as an individual standing alone.
Total enclosure extends the rule without leaving members outside its scope.
The very self or individual supplies the unit to which accountability is distributed.
A pledge held against a right supplies the binding relation attaching consequence to each self.

structural_cues: 74:11 presents the resistant person as created alone despite the social and material advantages that follow.
74:38 uses a universal quantifier with a singular self and a singular pledge immediately after the focus section.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies solitude, total scope, individual selfhood, and pledge; I connect them to the focus root's distributive-singularity branch and infer one-by-one application as a dimension of greatness. The live alternative is that إِحْدَى remains only partitive and does not inherit this distribution.

changed_reading.before: One identifies only the warning's membership in a class.
changed_reading.after: The one great warning also singularizes its audience, attaching consequence to every self one by one.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because Saqar is the stronger nearby feminine referent, but the focus inventory explicitly anchors major offense and the surah supplies defiance, self-exaltation, criminality, and denial. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary moral echo, not as a settled antecedent claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْكُبَرِ activates the major-sin branch when the pronoun is allowed to package the resistant stance.

activation_trace.role: The major-offense image provides the direct focus anchor for a moral classification.
Deviation from straightness and resistance to truth supplies the stance being classified.
Self-magnification and refusal sharpen the stance into culpable pride.
Sin and offense supply the later category into which the stance can be placed.
Attributing falsehood supplies denial as the culminating offense.

changed_reading.before: The pronoun denotes a great punishment or warning.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary echo, it can package defiant denial itself as one of the grave offenses that lead to that punishment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and form-distant because the focus is vocalized كُبَر while the cited branch is الكَبَر, a drum. It remains anchored in the exact focus root inventory and is activated by the surah's struck, sounding ناقور; render it only as an acoustic resonance, never as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ك ب ر inventory contains a one-faced drum branch beneath the ordinary greatness reading.

activation_trace.role: The drum image supplies a latent struck-instrument undertone to the declaration of greatness.
Rapid struck sound activates the drum undertone as an alarm signal.

changed_reading.before: Greatness is visualized as scale, rank, or consequence.
changed_reading.after: A contained acoustic layer makes the line reverberate like one of the great alarm-strokes announced by the trumpet.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the high-part-of-day branch is not the ordinary morphology of plural كُبَر. It remains focus-anchored and is immediately activated by dawn and uncovering light; downstream prose should use it as temporal texture, not as a replacement gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ك ب ر inventory includes the high or advanced part of the day.

activation_trace.role: The high-day image gives greatness a temporal ascent toward full daylight.
Dawn as the first of day supplies the temporal starting point.
The shining disclosure of light supplies the movement from dawn toward visible height.

changed_reading.before: The referent is great in an atemporal scalar sense.
changed_reading.after: A contained daylight resonance gives its greatness the texture of disclosure rising from dawn toward full height.

strongest_changes: The context narrows the open feminine referent toward Saqar and recasts greatness as an embodied warning operation.
The nineteen-count-trial sequence activates the numerical branch of one and makes the great member an epistemic assay.
Opposed magnifications turn greatness into a verdict against self-exaltation, while the night-to-dawn and advance-to-delay sequence makes it a disclosure-threshold.
Solitary creation and each self under pledge activate an individual-by-individual reach beneath the partitive one.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package changed both focus roots across distant structures: ء ح د moved from simple partitive membership into counting and individualization, while ك ب ر became consequential severity and a contest over rightful greatness; its drum and high-day branches survived only as contained resonances.
remaining_uncertainties: The feminine pronoun may target Saqar specifically, the fire complex, the count-as-trial, or the warning-reminder as a whole.
The numerical frame may alter the focus referent or may only intensify how Saqar is presented.
The grave-offense, drum, and high-day activations are branch-valid but too form- or antecedent-distant to serve as unqualified glosses.
